details.description: Toppy-M-7B is a 7-billion-parameter model built on Mistral-7B-v0.1, created by independent developer Undi95 by merging several fine-tuned Mistral models — openchat/openchat_3.5, NousResearch/Nous-Capybara-7B-V1.9, HuggingFaceH4/zephyr-7b-beta, plus roleplay-oriented LoRAs (lemonilia/AshhLimaRP-Mistral-7B, Vulkane/120-Days-of-Sodom-LoRA-Mistral-7b and Undi95/Mistral-pippa-sharegpt-7b-qlora) — using mergekit's task_arithmetic method. Fireworks AI, which hosts the model, lists a 32.7K-token context window. The model is tagged "Not-For-All-Audiences" on Hugging Face and licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0 for non-commercial use, reflecting the roleplay- and adult-content-oriented material in some of its merged components.
advantages: Merges several instruction- and roleplay-tuned Mistral-7B models (openchat_3.5, Nous-Capybara-7B-V1.9, zephyr-7b-beta, plus roleplay LoRAs) using mergekit's task_arithmetic method, per Undi95's model card.
disadvantages: Licensed CC-BY-NC-4.0, restricting use to non-commercial purposes, per Undi95's model card.
Tagged "Not-For-All-Audiences" on Hugging Face, per Undi95's model card.
No benchmark scores are published by the maker.
use_cases: Creative writing, given its merge of roleplay- and story-focused fine-tunes

notes: Catalog facts give a flat 32768-token max input/output; Fireworks' host page independently states a 32.7K-token context window, which is consistent. No maker-published benchmark numbers were found, so evaluations is left empty rather than guessed.
